lines_en: Culture is not wallpaper: formations, lantern light, dragon-lantern characters, and feast morale shape the rules.
The event brief's creative directions: coastal resistance, castle defense, family heritage, festival processions, water-town life, and future imaginings.

lines_zh: © 2026 xingwangzhe。保留署名权。
代码：GPL-3.0-or-later。
原创非代码资产：CC BY 4.0。

角色锻造模板图集：4 肤色 × 12 服装 × 11 头饰 × 4 背挂 × 43 套主副手组合，共 90,816 种；128×128×48 帧；14 类武器各 5 段具名动作，并区分单手、双手、远程与副手；17 套人体骨架含 3 类双持组合；肩肘髋膝踝共享骨架端点，所有握法双臂固定在躯干前层；双持主手按真实配对行生成，盾与副手为独立层；源文件 pixel-art/character_forge/build.py，按 CC BY 4.0 发布。参考包仅研究动作结构，未打包。
UI 面板与控件素材：WorkBuddy ImageGen 生成面板底板，tools/build_ui_controls.py 派生按钮、下拉、滑条、开关、滚动条与提示框；原创非代码资产 CC BY 4.0，详见《AI 使用与素材声明》。
第三方音乐、字体、音效保留原许可；署名与来源见上方条目。
霞鹜文楷：OFL 1.1，版权归 LXGW 与 Klee Project Authors，全文见 game/assets/fonts/OFL.txt。
本作与永昌堡、汤和信俗相关机构无隶属关系；历史资料仅用于文化考据与创作。
lines_en: © 2026 xingwangzhe. Attribution rights reserved.
Code: GPL-3.0-or-later.
Original non-code assets: CC BY 4.0.

Character-forge template atlases: 4 skins × 12 outfits × 11 headgear × 4 backgear × 43 main/offhand loadouts, 90,816 combinations; 128×128 across 48 frames; 14 weapon classes each with five named actions, separated into one-handed, two-handed, ranged, and offhand grips; 17 body skeletons including three dual-wield combo families; shared shoulder/elbow/hip/knee/ankle endpoints and both arms locked to the front of the torso for every grip; dual-wield main hands use pair-specific weapon rows, with shield/offhand on a separate layer; generated by pixel-art/character_forge/build.py, released under CC BY 4.0. Reference packs informed motion structure only and are not packaged.

UI panels and controls: panel base generated with WorkBuddy ImageGen; buttons, dropdowns, sliders, toggles, scrollbars, and tooltips derived by tools/build_ui_controls.py; original non-code assets under CC BY 4.0. See the AI Use & Asset Statement.
Third-party music, fonts, and sound effects keep their original licenses; see the entries above.
LXGW WenKai: OFL 1.1, copyright LXGW and the Klee Project Authors; full text in game/assets/fonts/OFL.txt.
This work is not affiliated with Yongchang Fort or Tang He tradition institutions; historical material is used for cultural research and creative work.
